description: Sealed evidence for the META score-attribution research doc (orchestrator PR #475: why the live XGB panel's META raw score fell 07-06→-0.176 while META rallied +11.5%). Codex reviewed PR #475 CHANGES_REQUESTED: the original doc overclaimed a 'LEARNED ... dispersion tilt' / '74% root cause' / economic verdict from an approximate, off-manifold, non-causal attribution. This bundle exists so the corrected doc's defensible claim -- 'same-model, approximate replay suggests sensitivity to the STD60 feature on this path; this does NOT establish a 74% root cause, an economic dispersion premium, or a reason to change the strategy' -- rests on sealed, content-addressed inputs/outputs rather than mutable local scratch state.
extraction_method: Standalone offline replay of the live serving path (backtesting/renquant_104/kernel/panel_pipeline/job_panel_scoring.py::ApplyScoresTask): alpha158 features computed online from the OHLCV cache, 5 fundamentals features from sec_fundamentals_daily.parquet (as-of, context-median-filled), PEAD/SUE from earnings_surprise/ (60d decay, context-median-filled), sentiment zeroed under the BULL_CALM trained-zeroing gate, then the pinned artifact's clip/global-z transform, scored with the pinned booster (xgboost 2.1.4, pred_contribs=True for SHAP). All reads read-only; no production path written; no git operation in the live umbrella tree or primary checkouts; isolated worktree; local compute only. Script: reproduce_meta.py (this bundle).

model_fingerprint.panel_artifact_path: backtesting/renquant_104/artifacts/prod/panel-ltr.alpha158_fund.json (live umbrella tree; read-only sha256, NOT copied into this store)
model_fingerprint.verification_note: Full sha256 computed read-only 2026-07-11 against the live production path; matches the '5211f6be…' prefix cited in the research doc and the run-bundle-recorded panel sha for all three sessions (07-06 ebb9c2ca, 07-07 dc2a3247, 07-10 6f9d5284), and its 07-09/07-10/07-11 weekly_rollback copies -- confirming the model was byte-stable across the whole attribution window.

transform_fingerprint.status: not independently sealed -- does not exist as a separate object
transform_fingerprint.note: The serving transform (feature_cols + clip/global-z stats) is embedded in the same panel artifact file fingerprinted above; there is no separate transform artifact in the current serving path to fingerprint independently. booster.json in this bundle is the booster_raw_json field extracted from that artifact (for standalone xgboost.Booster reproduction) -- its own sha256 below is a derived-extract hash, not an independent model/transform fingerprint.

universe_as_of_snapshot.note: demean_cross_sectional=false confirmed directly from this pinned commit's configs/strategy_config.json -- the 2026-06-25 monitored demean exception is not active in this snapshot.

meta_specific.note: computed directly from repro_summary.parquet, this bundle

reproduction_fidelity.codex_point_a_status: max_abs_diff (0.144-0.187/day) is now measured and sealed here -- it is LARGER than META's entire recorded weekly move (0.130), confirming Codex's point that this reproduction error is material, not incidental. Rank-order agreement, gate-decision agreement, and a SHAP additivity residual check are NOT computed in this bundle -- see absent_fields.

shap_top_contributors_meta.note: top-|contribution| features per day from contribs_<day>.parquet (xgboost pred_contribs), this bundle. This is model-representation attribution (SHAP-style), not a causal economic decomposition -- see the research doc's Known Limitations (d).

pdp_sweep_summary.caveat: single-row, off-manifold sweep on META's actual 07-10 feature row -- ROC/MIN/KLEN/CORD60 and the rest of the technical family held fixed at META's actual values while STD60 alone is varied. Not a conditional ALE/SHAP sweep. See the research doc's STD60-confound section and Known Limitations (c).

files.reproduce_meta.py: the exact reproduction/attribution script run to produce every number in this bundle and cited in the research doc
files.booster.json: booster_raw_json extracted from the pinned panel artifact, loadable standalone via xgboost.Booster().load_model()
files.recorded_scores.json: recorded live serving rows (raw_panel, rank_score, mu, etc.) for the three sessions, pulled from the run bundles, used as the reproduction target
files.repro_summary.parquet: per-ticker, per-day predicted vs. recorded raw score and diff for all three sessions -- source of the reproduction_fidelity numbers above
files.contribs_2026-07-06.parquet: full per-ticker SHAP contribution matrix (xgboost pred_contribs), 2026-07-06
files.features_raw_2026-07-06.parquet: exact as-of raw feature snapshot fed to the booster, 2026-07-06 (universe/as-of snapshot)
files.std60_sweep.csv: raw partial-dependence sweep output (STD60 value -> predicted score) on META's 07-10 row

absent_fields: An independent transform fingerprint distinct from the panel artifact -- does not exist as a separate object in the current serving path.
Rank-order agreement between the replay and the live serving ranks (not computed).
Gate-decision agreement -- whether replay error would flip any veto/admission decision (not computed).
Conditional ALE / conditional SHAP outputs (not computed -- the sealed PDP sweep is the single-row, off-manifold version Codex flagged as insufficient).
A path-consistent rescore recomputing every dependent technical feature from a valid counterfactual price path (not computed).
Any pre-registered walk-forward forward-test result (the forward test described in the research doc is a design sketch only; it has not been run).
